summary: Qikiqtarjuaq Airport (YVM) is a small community airport serving the Inuit hamlet of Qikiqtarjuaq on Broughton Island in Nunavut, Canada. The airport functions as a vital transportation link for the isolated community of roughly 600 residents and serves as one of the access points for travelers heading to Auyuittuq National Park, known for its towering peaks including the iconic Mount Asgard.

Q: What airlines fly into Qikiqtarjuaq Airport?
A: Canadian North operates scheduled passenger service to Qikiqtarjuaq, typically connecting through Iqaluit. Flights are limited and may be subject to weather delays common in the Arctic.

Q: Can I reach Auyuittuq National Park from this airport?
A: Yes, Qikiqtarjuaq provides access to the park, though most visitors enter through Pangnirtung. A local guide or outfitter is strongly recommended for park excursions due to rugged terrain and changing weather.

Q: Is the airport open year-round?
A: Yes, the airport operates year-round, though winter operations are subject to severe weather, whiteout conditions, and extreme cold that can cause delays or cancellations.
